_comment: Traits and features as definitions for the rules kernel (realmwalker/rules/engine/traits.py): creature traits by id, race traits and class features by their 'rule' tag, other features by id. modifiers: numbers and flags, with 'when' tests; hooks: what happens at the battle's events, by handler (rules/engine/handlers/); resource: a pool of uses and when it comes back; where 'sheet': handled by the character sheet or another system, nothing to do in a fight.

item_ward_poison.name: Warded against poison
item_ward_poison.text: A magic thing's gift: poison cannot make them sick.

item_ward_mind.name: Warded mind
item_ward_mind.text: A magic thing's gift: nothing can charm or frighten them.

item_ward_senses.name: Warded senses
item_ward_senses.text: A magic thing's gift: never blinded, deafened, turned to stone or stunned.

item_regeneration.name: Mending
item_regeneration.text: A magic thing's gift: 1d6 hit points back at the start of each turn, while at least one is left.

item_force.name: Force
item_force.text: A magic thing's gift: every hit with an attack roll does 1d6 force damage more.

item_weak_body.name: Weakened body
item_weak_body.text: A magic thing's flaw: Strength and Constitution checks and saves at a disadvantage.

item_weak_mind.name: Clouded will
item_weak_mind.text: A magic thing's flaw: Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves at a disadvantage.

item_frail_poison.name: Frail against poison
item_frail_poison.text: A magic thing's flaw: poison does double harm.

item_frail_all.name: Frail
item_frail_all.text: A magic thing's flaw: every harm does double.

pack_tactics.name: Pack Tactics
pack_tactics.text: Strikes at an advantage when a friend stands beside its prey.

keen_senses.name: Keen Senses
keen_senses.text: A sharp nose and sharp ears: hard to sneak up on.

takes_food.name: Scavenger
takes_food.text: Goes for the food in a camp.

relentless.name: Relentless
relentless.text: Once, a blow that would fell it leaves it standing at 1 hit point, if the blow was not too great.

web_walker.name: Web Walker
web_walker.text: Walks through webs as if they were not there.

leader.name: Leader
leader.text: When it falls, the others lose heart.

dark_devotion.name: Dark Devotion
dark_devotion.text: Its faith steadies it against fear and charms.

undead.name: Undead
undead.text: Neither eats nor sleeps nor breathes.

undead_fortitude.name: Undead Fortitude
undead_fortitude.text: Struck down, it may get up again unless the blow was holy or crushing.

aggressive.name: Aggressive
aggressive.text: Charges in: a bonus action to close the distance.

nimble_escape.name: Nimble Escape
nimble_escape.text: Strikes and slips away (Disengage or Hide as a bonus action).

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.text: Heals 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns, unless fire or acid burned it.

bloodied_fury.name: Bloodied Fury
bloodied_fury.text: Bloodied, it attacks at an advantage.

bloodied_frenzy.name: Bloodied Frenzy
bloodied_frenzy.text: Bloodied, it attacks and saves at an advantage.

spider_climb.name: Spider Climb
spider_climb.text: Climbs walls and ceilings as easily as floors.

abduct.name: Abduct
abduct.text: Drags whoever it holds at no extra cost.

loathsome_limbs.name: Loathsome Limbs
loathsome_limbs.text: Cut deep enough, its severed limbs fight on (not yet in the game).

training.name: Training
training.text: Trained in one skill of its trade.

charge.name: Charge
charge.text: A bonus action: half its speed straight at an enemy it can see.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.text: Once a day, after hurting a bloodied foe, it closes in and rends again.

parry.name: Parry
parry.text: A reaction: +2 AC against a melee blow that would hit.

redirect_attack.name: Redirect Attack
redirect_attack.text: Swaps places with a small ally to take a blow meant for it (not yet in the game).

sunlight_sensitive.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
sunlight_sensitive.text: Fights badly under an open, bright sky.

darkvision.name: Darkvision
darkvision.text: Sees in the dark, in shades of grey.

fey_ancestry.name: Fey Ancestry
fey_ancestry.text: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end being charmed.

trance.name: Trance
trance.text: Four hours of trance rest an elf like a night's sleep.

poison_resilience.name: Dwarven Resilience
poison_resilience.text: Resistance to poison damage, and advantage on saving throws to avoid or end being poisoned.

hp_per_level.name: Dwarven Toughness
hp_per_level.text: One more hit point at every level.

lucky.name: Luck
lucky.text: A natural 1 on an attack roll or a saving throw is rolled again.

brave.name: Brave
brave.text: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end being frightened.

relentless_endurance.name: Relentless Endurance
relentless_endurance.text: Once a day, a blow that would fell them leaves them standing at 1 hit point.

resourceful.name: Resourceful
resourceful.text: Heroic Inspiration after every long rest (2024 humans): one failed roll tried again.

savage_attacks.name: Savage Attacks
savage_attacks.text: A critical hit in melee rolls one more weapon die.

fighting_style.name: Fighting Style
fighting_style.text: A way of fighting, chosen once (archery, defence, duelling, great weapon, protection, two weapons).

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.text: A bonus action to catch one's breath: 1d10 + level hit points back (two uses, three from level 4, four from 10; a short rest brings one back).

action_surge.name: Action Surge
action_surge.text: One more action, once between rests (twice from level 17, never twice in a turn).

extra_attack.name: Extra Attack
extra_attack.text: Two attacks with the Attack action.

indomitable.name: Indomitable
indomitable.text: A failed saving throw rolled again, adding the fighter's level (once between long rests, twice from 13, three times from 17).

crit_19.name: Improved Critical
crit_19.text: A critical hit on a 19 or 20.

crit_18.name: Superior Critical
crit_18.text: A critical hit on an 18, 19 or 20.

extra_attack_2.name: Two Extra Attacks
extra_attack_2.text: Three attacks with the Attack action.

extra_attack_3.name: Three Extra Attacks
extra_attack_3.text: Four attacks with the Attack action.

tactical_mind.name: Tactical Mind
tactical_mind.text: A failed ability check: a use of Second Wind adds 1d10 (not spent if it still fails).

tactical_shift.name: Tactical Shift
tactical_shift.text: Second Wind also lets the fighter move half their speed, slipping away from the foes around them.

tactical_master.name: Tactical Master
tactical_master.text: A mastered weapon's blow may push, sap or slow instead of its own trick.

studied_attacks.name: Studied Attacks
studied_attacks.text: A miss: advantage on the next attack at that foe before the end of the fighter's next turn.

remarkable_athlete.name: Remarkable Athlete
remarkable_athlete.text: Advantage on initiative and Strength (Athletics) checks; after a critical hit, half the speed in a step that draws no blows.

heroic_warrior.name: Heroic Warrior
heroic_warrior.text: In a fight, Heroic Inspiration at the start of each turn without it.

survivor.name: Survivor
survivor.text: Advantage on death saves (18-20 counts as a 20); bloodied but standing, 5 + Constitution modifier hit points back at the start of each turn.

knight_unyielding.name: Unyielding
knight_unyielding.text: Once between long rests, a blow that would drop the knight leaves them standing with hit points equal to their level.

warden_of_the_line.name: Warden of the Line
warden_of_the_line.text: Hold the Line reaches ten feet.

hold_the_line.name: Hold the Line
hold_the_line.text: Enemies beside the knight strike badly at anyone else.

rallying_cry.name: Rallying Cry
rallying_cry.text: Second Wind also heals friends within 30 feet by the knight's level.

expertise.name: Expertise
expertise.text: Twice the proficiency bonus with two skills.

sneak_attack.name: Sneak Attack
sneak_attack.text: Once a turn, extra dice of damage with a finesse or ranged weapon, given advantage or a friend beside the target.

steady_aim.name: Steady Aim
steady_aim.text: A bonus action before moving: advantage on the next attack this turn, and no more moving.

roving_aim.name: Roving Aim
roving_aim.text: Steady Aim does not root the assassin to the spot.

cunning_strike.name: Cunning Strike
cunning_strike.text: Sneak Attack dice given up for a trick: poison, trip or withdraw.

improved_cunning_strike.name: Improved Cunning Strike
improved_cunning_strike.text: Two Cunning Strike tricks on one blow.

devious_strikes.name: Devious Strikes
devious_strikes.text: Daze, obscure and knock out as Cunning Strike tricks.

supreme_sneak.name: Supreme Sneak
supreme_sneak.text: Stealth Attack: a blow from hiding that does not give the thief away.

envenom_weapons.name: Envenom Weapons
envenom_weapons.text: A Cunning Strike's poison also deals 2d6 poison damage through any resistance.

death_strike.name: Death Strike
death_strike.text: A Sneak Attack in the first round: a Constitution save, or the damage is doubled.

reliable_talent.name: Reliable Talent
reliable_talent.text: A trained check never rolls lower than 10.

elusive.name: Elusive
elusive.text: No attack roll against them has advantage unless they are incapacitated.

stroke_of_luck.name: Stroke of Luck
stroke_of_luck.text: Once between rests, a failed attack roll or saving throw becomes a 20.

second_story_work.name: Second-Story Work
second_story_work.text: A climbing speed equal to the walking one; leaps by Dexterity.

use_magic_device.name: Use Magic Device
use_magic_device.text: Four magic things bound instead of three; charges kept on a 6.

thiefs_reflexes.name: Thief's Reflexes
thiefs_reflexes.text: In the first round, a second action, bonus action and move.

cunning_action.name: Cunning Action
cunning_action.text: Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

uncanny_dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge
uncanny_dodge.text: A reaction halves the damage of a blow seen coming.

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.text: A Dexterity save against an area: nothing on a success, half on a failure.

fast_hands.name: Fast Hands
fast_hands.text: Uses an object with a bonus action.

assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassinate.text: Advantage on initiative; in the first round, advantage against anyone who has not yet acted, and a Sneak Attack adds the rogue's level.

channel_divinity.name: Channel Divinity
channel_divinity.text: The god's power called on directly: Divine Spark or Turn Undead (two uses, three from level 6, four from 18; a short rest brings back one).

destroy_undead.name: Destroy Undead
destroy_undead.text: Turned undead of low challenge are destroyed outright.

divine_intervention.name: Divine Intervention
divine_intervention.text: Once between long rests the god answers: a cleric spell of level 5 or lower cast without a slot.

activate.name: Divine Intervention (a spell without a slot)

sear_undead.name: Sear Undead
sear_undead.text: Undead that fail against Turn Undead take a d8 of radiant damage per point of Wisdom.

order_thaumaturge.name: Thaumaturge
order_thaumaturge.text: One more cantrip; Wisdom added to Arcana and Religion.

blessed_divine_strike.name: Divine Strike
blessed_divine_strike.text: Once a turn, a weapon hit deals 1d8 radiant more (2d8 from level 14).

blessed_potent_spellcasting.name: Potent Spellcasting
blessed_potent_spellcasting.text: Wisdom added to cleric cantrips' damage; from 14, temporary hit points for a friend.

blessed_healer.name: Blessed Healer
blessed_healer.text: Healing another with a spell heals the cleric 2 + its level.

supreme_healing.name: Supreme Healing
supreme_healing.text: Healing dice count as their highest.

war_gods_blessing.name: War God's Blessing
war_gods_blessing.text: Channel Divinity casts Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon without a slot.

activate.name: War God's Blessing: Shield of Faith

avatar_of_battle.name: Avatar of Battle
avatar_of_battle.text: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

disciple_of_life.name: Disciple of Life
disciple_of_life.text: Healing spells heal 2 + the spell's level more.

preserve_life.name: Preserve Life
preserve_life.text: Channel Divinity: five times the cleric's level in healing, shared among the wounded.

war_priest.name: War Priest
war_priest.text: A weapon attack as a bonus action, a few times a day.

guided_strike.name: Guided Strike
guided_strike.text: Channel Divinity: +10 to an attack roll that would have missed, the cleric's own or a friend's within 30 feet.

arcane_recovery.name: Arcane Recovery
arcane_recovery.text: Spell slots back on a short rest, once between long rests: half the level in slot levels, none above 5.

ritual_adept.name: Ritual Adept
ritual_adept.text: Rituals cast from the spellbook, ready or not.

memorize_spell.name: Memorize Spell
memorize_spell.text: A prepared spell swapped after a short rest.

spell_mastery.name: Spell Mastery
spell_mastery.text: A level 1 and a level 2 spell cast at will.

signature_spells.name: Signature Spells
signature_spells.text: Two level 3 spells cast once each without a slot, back with a short rest.

potent_cantrip.name: Potent Cantrip
potent_cantrip.text: A cantrip that misses or is saved against still does half its damage.

sculpt_spells.name: Sculpt Spells
sculpt_spells.text: Friends can be left out of the wizard's evocations.

empowered_evocation.name: Empowered Evocation
empowered_evocation.text: Evocations add the wizard's Intelligence modifier to one damage roll.

overchannel.name: Overchannel
overchannel.text: A spell of level 1 to 5 at its greatest damage; after the first time, at a price in necrotic.

arcane_ward.name: Arcane Ward
arcane_ward.text: The first abjuration cast with a slot after a long rest weaves a ward that takes blows; each one after mends it, and a slot can be poured into it.

activate.name: Arcane Ward: mend it with a spell slot (bonus action)

spell_breaker.name: Spell Breaker
spell_breaker.text: Counterspell always ready; its slot kept when the spell holds.

spell_resistance.name: Spell Resistance
spell_resistance.text: Advantage on saves against spells; their damage halved.

projected_ward.name: Projected Ward
projected_ward.text: The ward can take a blow meant for a friend within 30 feet.

weapon_mastery.name: Weapon Mastery
weapon_mastery.text: Uses the mastery property of the weapons it has mastered.

mastery_cleave.name: Cleave
mastery_cleave.text: A melee hit carries on into a second foe beside the first, once a turn: the weapon's damage without the ability bonus.

mastery_graze.name: Graze
mastery_graze.text: A miss still cuts: damage equal to the ability bonus of the attack.

mastery_nick.name: Nick
mastery_nick.text: The Light weapon's extra blow is part of the Attack action instead of a bonus action, once a turn.

mastery_push.name: Push
mastery_push.text: A hit drives a Large or smaller creature 10 feet straight back.

mastery_sap.name: Sap
mastery_sap.text: A hit leaves the creature at a disadvantage on its next attack before your next turn.

mastery_slow.name: Slow
mastery_slow.text: A hit that wounds takes 10 feet off its speed until your next turn (not more, however many hit it).

mastery_topple.name: Topple
mastery_topple.text: A hit forces a Constitution save (DC 8 + the attack's ability bonus + proficiency) or it falls prone.

mastery_vex.name: Vex
mastery_vex.text: A hit that wounds gives advantage on your next attack against that creature before the end of your next turn.

halfling_nimbleness.name: Halfling Nimbleness
halfling_nimbleness.text: Moves through the space of any creature a size larger.

stonecunning.name: Stonecunning
stonecunning.text: A bonus action on stone: tremorsense to 60 feet for ten minutes, as many times a long rest as the proficiency bonus.

adrenaline_rush.name: Adrenaline Rush
adrenaline_rush.text: A bonus action: Dash, and temporary hit points equal to the proficiency bonus; as many times a short rest as the proficiency bonus.

feat_alert.name: Alert
feat_alert.text: The proficiency bonus is added to initiative.

feat_crafter.name: Crafter
feat_crafter.text: A fifth off plain goods in shops; three kinds of artisan's tools.

feat_healer.name: Healer
feat_healer.text: Battle Medic with a healer's kit; healing dice of 1 rolled again.

feat_lucky.name: Lucky
feat_lucky.text: Luck points (the proficiency bonus, back after a long rest): a missed attack or a failed save rolled again.

feat_magic_initiate.name: Magic Initiate
feat_magic_initiate.text: Two cantrips and a level 1 spell, cast once a long rest without a slot.

feat_musician.name: Musician
feat_musician.text: After a rest, Heroic Inspiration for companions.

feat_savage_attacker.name: Savage Attacker
feat_savage_attacker.text: Once a turn, a weapon's damage dice rolled twice, the higher kept.

feat_tavern_brawler.name: Tavern Brawler
feat_tavern_brawler.text: Fists 1d4 + Strength, 1s rolled again; improvised weapons with proficiency; a punch shoves 5 feet once a turn.

ability_score_improvement.name: Ability Score Improvement
ability_score_improvement.text: +2 to one ability or +1 to two (at most 20), or a feat instead: the choice at levels 4 and 8.

feat_tough.name: Tough
feat_tough.text: Two more hit points at every level.

feat_actor.name: Actor
feat_actor.text: +1 Charisma; a disguise played well; voices mimicked.

feat_athlete.name: Athlete
feat_athlete.text: A Climb Speed equal to the Speed; up from the ground with 5 feet of movement.

feat_charger.name: Charger
feat_charger.text: A Dash goes 10 feet further; once a turn, after a 10-foot run at a foe, a melee hit deals 1d8 more or drives it 10 feet back.

feat_chef.name: Chef
feat_chef.text: Treats after a long rest (the proficiency bonus of them): one eaten with a bonus action gives temporary hit points.

feat_crossbow_expert.name: Crossbow Expert
feat_crossbow_expert.text: No Loading for crossbows; no disadvantage with them beside a foe; the off-hand crossbow adds Dexterity.

feat_crusher.name: Crusher
feat_crusher.text: Once a turn a bludgeoning hit shoves 5 feet; a bludgeoning critical hit gives everyone advantage against the foe until your next turn.

feat_defensive_duelist.name: Defensive Duelist
feat_defensive_duelist.text: With a finesse weapon in hand, the reaction adds the proficiency bonus to AC against melee blows until your next turn.

feat_dual_wielder.name: Dual Wielder
feat_dual_wielder.text: The off-hand blow may be made with any one-handed melee weapon, light or not.

feat_durable.name: Durable
feat_durable.text: Advantage on death saves; a bonus action spends a Hit Die to heal.

activate.name: Speedy Recovery: spend a Hit Die (bonus action)

feat_elemental_adept.name: Elemental Adept
feat_elemental_adept.text: Spells of the chosen element ignore resistance to it; a 1 on their damage dice counts as a 2.

feat_fey_touched.name: Fey Touched
feat_fey_touched.text: Misty Step and a level 1 divination or enchantment spell, once a long rest each without a slot.

feat_grappler.name: Grappler
feat_grappler.text: Once a turn a punch also grabs; advantage on attacks against the one you hold; dragging them costs nothing extra.

feat_great_weapon_master.name: Great Weapon Master
feat_great_weapon_master.text: A Heavy weapon's hit deals the proficiency bonus more; a melee critical hit or a foe dropped earns a bonus-action blow (Hew).

feat_heavy_armor_master.name: Heavy Armor Master
feat_heavy_armor_master.text: In heavy armour, bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage is cut by the proficiency bonus.

feat_inspiring_leader.name: Inspiring Leader
feat_inspiring_leader.text: After a rest, up to six companions gain temporary hit points (level + the ability's modifier).

feat_keen_mind.name: Keen Mind
feat_keen_mind.text: A lore skill; Study with a bonus action.

feat_lightly_armored.name: Lightly Armored
feat_lightly_armored.text: Training with light armour and shields.

feat_mage_slayer.name: Mage Slayer
feat_mage_slayer.text: A caster you hurt saves to keep a spell going at a disadvantage; once between rests a failed Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma save succeeds.

feat_medium_armor_master.name: Medium Armor Master
feat_medium_armor_master.text: Medium armour takes up to 3 of the Dexterity bonus into AC.

feat_moderately_armored.name: Moderately Armored
feat_moderately_armored.text: Training with medium armour and shields.

feat_mounted_combatant.name: Mounted Combatant
feat_mounted_combatant.text: A good rider (fighting from the saddle comes with a later expansion).

feat_observant.name: Observant
feat_observant.text: A keen sense; Search with a bonus action.

feat_piercer.name: Piercer
feat_piercer.text: Once a turn a piercing hit rolls its lowest damage die again; a piercing critical hit adds a die.

feat_poisoner.name: Poisoner
feat_poisoner.text: Poison damage you deal ignores resistance to it.

feat_polearm_master.name: Polearm Master
feat_polearm_master.text: A bonus-action blow with the butt end (1d4) after attacking with a polearm; the reaction strikes whoever steps into your reach.

feat_resilient.name: Resilient
feat_resilient.text: Proficiency in one more kind of saving throw.

feat_ritual_caster.name: Ritual Caster
feat_ritual_caster.text: Ritual spells cast outside a fight without a slot.

feat_sentinel.name: Sentinel
feat_sentinel.text: A foe beside you that disengages, or strikes someone else, invites your reaction blow; a creature it hits stops where it is.

feat_shadow_touched.name: Shadow Touched
feat_shadow_touched.text: Invisibility and a level 1 illusion or necromancy spell, once a long rest each without a slot.

feat_sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
feat_sharpshooter.text: Shots ignore half and three-quarters cover, a foe at hand and long range.

feat_shield_master.name: Shield Master
feat_shield_master.text: Once a turn after a melee hit, a shield bash knocks the foe back or down (Strength save); a good Dexterity save for half damage takes none (reaction).

feat_skill_expert.name: Skill Expert
feat_skill_expert.text: A skill, and expertise in one.

feat_skulker.name: Skulker
feat_skulker.text: Blindsight 10 feet; hiding with advantage; a missed attack does not give away where you hide.

feat_slasher.name: Slasher
feat_slasher.text: Once a turn a slashing hit takes 10 feet off the foe's speed; a slashing critical hit gives it disadvantage on its attacks until your next turn.

feat_speedy.name: Speedy
feat_speedy.text: 10 feet faster; a Dash ignores rough ground; blows struck as you break away have disadvantage.

feat_spell_sniper.name: Spell Sniper
feat_spell_sniper.text: Spell attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover and a foe at hand; spells with an attack roll reach 60 feet further.

feat_telekinetic.name: Telekinetic
feat_telekinetic.text: A bonus action shoves a creature within 30 feet 5 feet (Strength save).

feat_telepathic.name: Telepathic
feat_telepathic.text: Speech mind to mind; Detect Thoughts once a long rest.

feat_war_caster.name: War Caster
feat_war_caster.text: Advantage on saves to keep a spell going; a harmful cantrip may answer a foe breaking away.

feat_weapon_master.name: Weapon Master
feat_weapon_master.text: The mastery of one more kind of weapon.

style_dueling.name: Dueling
style_dueling.text: +2 damage with a one-handed melee weapon and no other weapon.

style_great_weapon_fighting.name: Great Weapon Fighting
style_great_weapon_fighting.text: A 1 or 2 on a damage die of a weapon held in both hands counts as a 3.

style_interception.name: Interception
style_interception.text: The reaction turns 1d10 + the proficiency bonus of a blow aside from a friend beside you.

style_protection.name: Protection
style_protection.text: With a shield, the reaction gives disadvantage to attacks on a friend beside you until your next turn.

style_two_weapon_fighting.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
style_two_weapon_fighting.text: The off-hand blow adds the ability modifier.

style_unarmed_fighting.name: Unarmed Fighting
style_unarmed_fighting.text: Fists 1d6 (1d8 with empty hands); anyone held takes 1d4 at the start of your turn.

feat_boon_of_combat_prowess.name: Boon of Combat Prowess
feat_boon_of_combat_prowess.text: Peerless Aim: once until the start of your next turn, a missed attack hits instead.

feat_boon_of_dimensional_travel.name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
feat_boon_of_dimensional_travel.text: Blink Steps: after attacking or casting on your turn, vanish and reappear up to 30 feet away, clear of the foes beside you.

feat_boon_of_energy_resistance.name: Boon of Energy Resistance
feat_boon_of_energy_resistance.text: Resistance to the two chosen kinds of harm; a reaction turns them on a foe within 60 feet (Dexterity save, 2d12 + Constitution modifier).

feat_boon_of_fate.name: Boon of Fate
feat_boon_of_fate.text: Improve Fate: once a fight, 2d4 added to a friend's saving throw or missed attack, or taken from a foe's saving throw, within 60 feet.

feat_boon_of_fortitude.name: Boon of Fortitude
feat_boon_of_fortitude.text: Forty more hit points; once a turn, healing restores the Constitution modifier more.

feat_boon_of_irresistible_offense.name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
feat_boon_of_irresistible_offense.text: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage ignores resistance; a 20 on the die adds damage equal to the ability score raised.

feat_boon_of_recovery.name: Boon of Recovery
feat_boon_of_recovery.text: Last Stand: once a day, standing again at half the hit points instead of falling. Recover Vitality: ten d10s to heal with, a bonus action.

activate.name: Recover Vitality: spend d10s to heal (bonus action)

feat_boon_of_skill.name: Boon of Skill
feat_boon_of_skill.text: Proficiency in every skill, and expertise in one more.

feat_boon_of_speed.name: Boon of Speed
feat_boon_of_speed.text: Thirty feet faster; Disengage as a bonus action, slipping any grip.

feat_boon_of_spell_recall.name: Boon of Spell Recall
feat_boon_of_spell_recall.text: Free Casting: a slot of level 1 to 4 is kept when a d4 shows its level.

feat_boon_of_the_night_spirit.name: Boon of the Night Spirit
feat_boon_of_the_night_spirit.text: In dim light or darkness: invisible as a bonus action (until you next act), and resistant to all harm but psychic and radiant.
